identity.fantasy: A fungal rot caster who spreads Wilt, spores, snakes, and disease, then uses Sepsis Bloom to control and detonate the infected field.
identity.one_line: A fungal rot caster who spreads Wilt, spores, snakes, and disease, then uses Sepsis Bloom to control and detonate the infected field. The defining decision is contextual: Target lifespan and mana decide whether to spread, refresh, or Bloom.

mechanics.core_loop: An Affliction-like rot caster using Wilt, Spore, Fungal Growth, snakes, and disease cycles. Sepsis Bloom can consume periodic effects for control and a delayed detonation, while fungal summons extend multi-target pressure. Recent players specifically compare it to Affliction Warlock with druid-like utility.

modes.name: Weaver Form
modes.structural_description: Level 30 PassiveTeaches you Weaver Form.Weaver Form (Shapeshift)Shapeshift into Weaver Form, allowing your periodic effects to benefit from spell haste, reducing spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by 70%, and giving periodic damage dealt a 5% chance to restore 5% of your missing mana.Cannot use healing spells while in Weaver Form.

modes.name: Fungal Assailant
modes.structural_description: Summon a Fungarian to attack an enemy, dealing 226 + 65% SP Nature damage, and instantly apply Debilitating Venom to your target. Lasts 20 seconds.Debilitating Venom (Slow)Movement speed slowed by -40% for 8 seconds.Can be used in any form.

modes.name: Mycelial Ring
modes.structural_description: Create an 8 yd ring beneath you for 10 seconds that deals 59 Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies inside and immediately grows 12 Mushrooms in a circle around you.At the end of the duration, up to 15 allies inside are healed for 845 + 65% nature SP.Can be used in any form.

mechanics.single_target: Maintain Wilt, Spore, and the fungal disease network, then use Sepsis Bloom only after periodic effects mature. Current players disagree whether this is an easy rot loop or timer-heavy micromanagement.
mechanics.aoe: Spread periodic effects and fungal summons before Blooming for control and delayed damage. Mana and target lifespan determine whether full setup is worthwhile.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged DoTs preserve pressure while moving, but the infection network is target-bound.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Mycosis, Weaver Form, Venom Saturation, Mycelial Ring.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Lethargy, Fungal Assailant, Fungal Link.

failure_modes.text: Blooming too early, letting timers fall, or spending mana on enemies that die before the delayed payoff wastes the rot network.
Refreshing every periodic effect on a target that will die soon spends mana without reaching the delayed payoff.
Losing track of one disease in a multi-target spread can weaken the Bloom decision across the whole pack.
